statement: A Special Summon whose words name a Ritual Monster in the hand or Deck ("Special Summon 1 'Nouvelles' Ritual Monster from your hand") can Summon one that hasn't been Ritual Summoned: the card says it can. That Summon isn't a proper one, so the monster still can't be Special Summoned from the GY or banishment afterwards. From the GY or banishment, the words are met by a Ritual Monster that was Summoned properly, so they let nothing else be Summoned.

gives.unsaid: a Ritual Monster Special Summoned from the hand or Deck and from elsewhere: its words let it ignore REVIVE_LIMIT from the first and not from the second, which one move can't say
a Ritual Monster Special Summoned after another move took it from where it was picked: whether that put it in the hand or Deck, where its words would let it ignore REVIVE_LIMIT, isn't followed

scripts: Poissonniere de Nouvelles's script agrees (nolimit), and so does Dragon Master Magia's.
